answers.assumption_check: Measured 2026-11-13 by akiendell on the Windows house checkout at d2a61adc9: with d95796cdfb9b's home_env setting USERPROFILE beside HOME, codemother/machines/clearance/proofs/test_clearance.py reds at its first scratch-HOME ask (:103) with '5432 fe_sendauth: no password supplied'; with only that line reverted it is green. store._conn_args on Windows dials TCP loopback with passfile= the pgpass under the instance root, falling back to the root the process started with (fc4bb2062253). In a scratch-HOME child both are the scratch, so no pgpass is found, and the explicit passfile= overrides libpq's own PGPASSFILE, so nothing outside store.py can supply it. Load-bearing: scratch.home_env (d95796cdfb9b D4) names the box the child was moved off in CAIRN_SCRATCH_BOX_INSTANCE, the caller's ~/.cairn, kept when already set, so the client can read the box's pgpass there. The variable carries a path, never a secret.
answers.builder_check: A Haiku builder needs: in store._conn_args, after the current-root pgpass and the startup pgpass, try <CAIRN_SCRATCH_BOX_INSTANCE>/devices/db_domain/0/pgpass when the variable is set; read the variable as a string so store.py imports nothing from the scratch tool; a tooth in the existing passfile proof. All are in the decisions.

answers.collision_check: fc4bb2062253 intends the same: a credential the scratch does not hold is still the box's. This adds the cross-process case to its in-process one, so the two whys agree. d95796cdfb9b D4 is the other half (scratch sets the variable); this ticket reads it and is inert without it.
answers.falsifier_check: One clause: with the current root and the startup root holding no pgpass, _conn_args names no existing passfile while CAIRN_SCRATCH_BOX_INSTANCE is unset, names <box>/devices/db_domain/0/pgpass once it names a box holding one, and a pgpass under the current root still wins over the box's. Plus, on a Windows box with Postgres, test_clearance.py is green with d95796cdfb9b's USERPROFILE in place.
